first_priority_action: STOP: Do not proceed with Series C conversations until churn trend is understood. Conduct immediate churn analysis: cohort retention curves, exit interviews, competitive loss analysis. Understand whether churn is normal market dynamics or signal of product-market fit deterioration. DO NOT let growth metrics anchor confidence in retention quality.
action_description: Diagnostic halt: churn doubling while growth accelerating is a major red flag. Series C investors will scrutinize retention; hidden churn problem will be discovered in due diligence. Better to diagnose now than during Series C discussions.
evidence_basis: Churn doubling from 2% to 4% MoM is a critical signal masked by growth celebration

constraint_awareness.rubric_10: Respects time constraint by diagnosing before Series C
